decisions: The analyzer product remains isolated under analyzer/ and inherited projects are reference-only.
ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers targets netstandard2.0 and is packaged as a Roslyn analyzer asset under analyzers/dotnet/cs/.
Roslyn package references remain private build/development dependencies pinned through analyzer/Directory.Packages.props.

No Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces, Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces, MathNet.Numerics, ProjectReference, binary reference, or local inherited package dependency is used by the analyzer project.
BIG9000 is the only Phase 1 diagnostic, is an infrastructure execution probe, is disabled by default, and reports at most once per compilation when explicitly enabled.
BIG9000 reports at a source location when source exists so consumer .editorconfig severity settings can enable it in real builds.
constraints: Do not implement Big-O analysis, BIG0001, BIG1001, ComplexityExpression, BCL mappings, recurrence solving, call graph analysis, CodeFixProvider, Workspaces, Solver, Engine, or inherited ports in Phase 1.
Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Keep analyzer package contents minimal and avoid runtime lib assets for the analyzer assembly.
validations: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore succeeded in analyzer/ with 1 warning and 0 errors.
dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build succeeded in analyzer/ with 9 passing tests.
dotnet pack for ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers 0.1.0-phase1 succeeded without publishing.
The nupkg contains ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers.dll only under analyzers/dotnet/cs/ plus README and NuGet metadata.
The nupkg nuspec has no dependency groups, so Roslyn is not exposed as a runtime transitive dependency.
Temporary consumer validation used PackageReference and a local NuGet source, with no ProjectReference.
Temporary consumer default build reported no BIG9000 diagnostics.
Temporary consumer build with dotnet_diagnostic.BIG9000.severity = warning reported one BIG9000 compiler diagnostic.
git diff main...HEAD contains only analyzer/ paths.

Inherited solution restore succeeded with an isolated no-cache packages folder; inherited solution Release build succeeded with documentation output redirected to analyzer/artifacts to avoid an environment file lock in the inherited MkDocs target.
